sourceDateOrCycle: INESS invitation post dated 11 Sep 2026; programme Thu 15 - Sun 18 Oct 2026 (edition number is inconsistent: INESS post headline says 5th, body says 4th)
deadline: Mon 5 Oct 2026 (weekday verified; time and timezone not stated; Slovakia CEST). Selection by quality of answers; applicants informed by email after close.
audience: Secondary and university students (priority); non-students and older applicants also accepted
eligibility: Basic economics knowledge and curiosity; the form asks status, age on 18.10.2026, school, two motivation answers; capacity limited and applicants are selected
funding: NOT FREE: EUR 159 students, EUR 299 non-students, EUR 109 reduced for students requesting a social/motivational scholarship; includes lodging, full board and economics literature; travel not included; no discount if lodging/meals unused; payment details sent to selected applicants
questionsForOutreach: Is a scholarship or travel support available for international applicants, and is English accepted (programme is in Slovak)?

FIT FLAGS: Slovak-language, in person in Slovakia, FEE-BASED seminar (EUR 159-299, travel extra), students prioritised, closes in 4 days. Robots allow.
